pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:0.6: Ime kho panāyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū purato pi pacchato pi olambentā nivāsenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā purato pi . . . nivāsessanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū purato pi . . . nivāsessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe [dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā] bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave purato pi . . . nivāsethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.18: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambento nivāseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
